---
description: job_cancel as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: cancelling a job
arguments:
  job: The id of the job, as job_start or job_list gave it.
---
Stops a job of this chat that an agent started and that has not ended. What it had written stays in its report. A job the player started is the player's to stop, and one that has ended is left as it is.
